tr: Öğrenciler fiziksel modelleri bilgisayarda çözmek için programlama ve sayısal yöntemler öğrenir.
en: Students learn programming and numerical methods for solving physical models on a computer.
de: Studierende lernen Programmierung und numerische Verfahren, um physikalische Modelle am Rechner zu lösen.

tr: Öğrenciler rastgeleliği modellemeyi ve verilerden olasılık ve istatistikle sonuç çıkarmayı öğrenir.
en: Students learn to model chance and to draw conclusions from data with probability and statistics.
de: Studierende lernen den Zufall zu modellieren und aus Daten mit Wahrscheinlichkeit und Statistik Schlüsse zu ziehen.

tr: Öğrenciler biyofizik için molekül yapısını, fizikokimyayı ve hücre biyolojisini öğrenir.
en: Students learn molecular structure, physical chemistry, and cell biology for work in biophysics.
de: Studierende lernen Molekülstruktur, physikalische Chemie und Zellbiologie für die Arbeit in der Biophysik.

tr: Öğrenciler teknik işler için sayısal elektroniği, bileşenleri, ölçmeyi ve kontrolü öğrenir.
en: Students learn digital electronics, components, measurement, and control for technical jobs.
de: Studierende lernen digitale Elektronik, Bauelemente, Messtechnik und Regelung für technische Berufe.

tr: Öğrenciler kuramsal fizikte kullanılan ileri analizi, cebiri ve fonksiyonel analizi öğrenir.
en: Students learn higher analysis, algebra, and functional analysis used in theoretical physics.
de: Studierende lernen höhere Analysis, Algebra und Funktionalanalysis für die theoretische Physik.

categories.name: Elective modules
categories.note: At least 23 ECTS in total, including 6 ECTS additive key competencies (PBS) and usually the 8-ECTS Berufspraktikum, which may be replaced by other electives.
categories.noteTr: Toplamda en az 23 ECTS. Buna 6 ECTS eklemeli anahtar yeterlikler (PBS) ve genellikle 8 ECTS'lik Berufspraktikum dahildir; Berufspraktikum diğer seçmelilerle değiştirilebilir.
categories.noteDe: Mindestens 23 ECTS insgesamt, darunter 6 ECTS additive Schlüsselkompetenzen (PBS) und in der Regel das Berufspraktikum im Umfang von 8 ECTS, das durch andere Wahlmodule ersetzt werden kann.

rulesSummary.en: PO 2019 §7: 145 ECTS of compulsory modules (PBP 1 to PBP 20, including the physics seminar and the advanced lab), at least 23 ECTS of electives from one mixed pool (physics, chemistry, biology, computer science, electrical engineering and mathematics, including 6 ECTS of additive key competencies and usually the 8-ECTS Berufspraktikum, which may be replaced), and the 12-ECTS thesis. The elective minimum is enforced as 23 ECTS.
rulesSummary.tr: PO 2019 § 7: 145 ECTS zorunlu modül (PBP 1'den PBP 20'ye, fizik semineri ve ileri laboratuvar dahil), karma bir havuzdan en az 23 ECTS seçmeli (fizik, kimya, biyoloji, bilişim, elektrik mühendisliği ve matematik; buna 6 ECTS ek anahtar yetkinlik ve kural olarak değiştirilebilen 8 ECTS'lik Berufspraktikum dahildir) ve 12 ECTS'lik tez. Seçmeli alt sınır 23 ECTS olarak uygulanır.
rulesSummary.de: PO 2019 § 7: 145 ECTS Pflichtmodule (PBP 1 bis PBP 20, einschließlich des Physikseminars und des Fortgeschrittenenpraktikums), mindestens 23 ECTS Wahlmodule aus einem gemischten Pool (Physik, Chemie, Biologie, Informatik, Elektrotechnik und Mathematik, darunter 6 ECTS additive Schlüsselkompetenzen und in der Regel das Berufspraktikum mit 8 ECTS, das ersetzt werden kann) sowie die Thesis mit 12 ECTS. Das Wahlminimum wird mit 23 ECTS durchgesetzt.

note.en: Free German courses of the Language Centre (ISZ), only for enrolled Uni Kassel students. Register with the ISZ, not in eCampus. Whether the credits count in your program depends on your PO (e.g. key competencies or Studium Generale).

note.de: Kostenfreie Deutschkurse des Sprachenzentrums (ISZ), nur für immatrikulierte Studierende der Uni Kassel. Die Anmeldung läuft über das ISZ, nicht über eCampus. Ob die Credits in deinem Studiengang zählen, regelt deine PO (z. B. Schlüsselkompetenzen oder Studium Generale).
